text: Two limits: (1) CI's token is read-only (permissions: contents: read), so CI never writes a checkpoint: it reads the newest checkpoint and judges incrementally on push, or replays fully on schedule. Checkpoints are written by a local run (athena check --attribution when it passes, and athena land after a landing record), pushed with the records writer. (2) A producer's working copy is a one-commit snapshot with no athena/records, so it cannot time this repository: measure on a synthetic repository in a test or a small bench (for example 200 landings), mark those numbers measured-on-fixture, and the real timing will be taken after landing.
